name: AnnoPred
model_likelihood: Standardized linear random-effects model; asymptotically Gaussian summary likelihood with mean D beta and covariance (1-h_g^2) D/N.
prior: Two empirical spike-and-slab alternatives: shared causal probability with annotation-dependent slab variance; or annotation-dependent causal probability with shared slab variance.
inference_algorithm: Estimate annotation contributions by stratified LD-score weighted least squares; rescale to chip heritability; run regional Gibbs sampling and average samples.
estimand: Posterior mean SNP effects and their genotype-weighted polygenic score.
data_input: GWAS marginal summary statistics; functional annotation assignments; reference-panel or validation-sample LD; target genotypes for scores.
tunable_settings: Prior family and overall causal proportion p0 selected by prediction in an independent cohort; annotation set; regional chunk size (paper uses total variant count divided by 3000).
